registered_tldr: TLDR: Local-agent variant of the nine-agent external-influence pilot. Qwen3 0.6B failed candidate coverage; 1.7B completed 3/6 teams and chose correctly in 2/6. A prospective 1.7B schema repair now enforces public candidate/citation constraints, measuring validity and correctness on six fresh clean/superior cases before any historical 50-case comparison. Zero API inference spend; exploratory development fixtures and backend differences limit conclusions.
run_tldr: TLDR: S1 replaces Haiku with qualified local qwen3:1.7b on the same 50 nine-agent assignments. Compare correctness, harmful choices, invalidity, regret and compute. Three task roots and historical backend confounding prevent general superiority claims.
